confirmation.feedback: After fixes the three facts Before lost: the nightly text is now passed as common context to all three scouts and asserted only in ABC-101's Context (Before held it for ABC-101 but never put it in the body or the briefs), the first turn no longer announces ABC-102's stop or ABC-103's roast result before the ABC-101 reply, and the ABC-103 uniqueness repair now removes the implied count-only row into a verbatim Reporter note while keeping the receipt row and the 12-row setup. Two residual risks: the preparation block still names 'the ABC-102 recovery question' and 'eligible tickets' for roast, which a strict reader could treat as disclosure of a later ticket's state — replace with a ref-free line such as 'recovery questions are asked only after all audits finish' and 'roast runs in ref order'. And the create checkpoint still says the single scout 'audits the ask once' with legacy rows 'never serialized or audited', matching Before's 'over the ask only'; the overlap fact wants the scout run over the clarified snapshot and the discovered candidate (so enrichment prose can be grounded) while findings touch only payload-local alternatives and protect legacy ACs. Word it as 'one scout reads the clarified snapshot and the candidate's untrusted block; findings fold only into create-anyway or added/changed enrichment prose; the candidate's legacy AC rows stay verbatim; no new gate is added.' Everything else (dedup, serial fetch, audit-above-title, local hard stop with no approval option, off-turn handling, re-fetch/compare then body-then-comment, one status line per ref, unfetched handling) is preserved from Before.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After fixes the big ones: ABC-102's wishful AC now stops only that ticket (no approval option, ABC-103 proceeds), every gate including the ABC-102 stop carries an Audit line directly above Title before recovery text, and (d) prescribes re-fetch/compare, description-then-comment, and ends with declined/stopped/written. It still misses first-gate, though for a narrower reason than Before: the preparation paragraph says 'ABC-102's recovery answer leaves a wishful AC and stops that ticket. ABC-103 requires substantive AC normalization and uniqueness repair' before the ABC-101 gate opens, which is later-ticket disclosure before the reply (Before disclosed far more — the full ABC-102 criterion and run-wide block — but After still leaks state). Replace those two sentences with a neutral line such as 'Preparation for all three refs is complete; tickets are presented one at a time in ref order' and drop the stray 'This proposed menu must not be used for mutation before preparation finishes' sentence, which contradicts the gate being open. Two smaller wording hazards that didn't flip a fact but could in a rerun: the ABC-103 gate first prints a wrong diff (duplicate count row retained) and then a 'Correction' diff — emit only the corrected single diff per changed body, since the case asked for one diff per body; and in (b) the appended Reporter-note line for the old receipt wording is fine as verbatim displaced detail but should be labeled as such so the note's accumulation rule is visible. Keep everything else as written: per-ticket admin/nightly scoping, single root and dedup, the verbatim two-row Reporter note for ABC-103, and the (c) refusal to approve an unseen diff all hold as in Before.
